citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.19.c (fractures: a fracture not indicated as open or closed is closed; a displaced fracture with no specified type is coded to the unspecified fracture of that site); Section I.C.19.a (7th character A for initial encounter while receiving active treatment, which includes ED evaluation and closed reduction); Section I.C.20.a and I.C.20.b (external cause, place of occurrence, activity, and status codes are assigned at the initial encounter)

coder_notes: S52.501A is the correct code even though 'displaced' is documented; the S52.5- series captures displacement only within specific fracture types, and no type is given. Y92.014 assumes a private residence; use Y92.9 if the facility does not infer that from 'painting a house.' Y99.9 because the note does not say whether this was paid work or a personal project. Traps: Assuming a Colles' fracture (S52.531A) because a displaced distal radius fracture in a fall sounds like one, when no fracture type is documented; assigning 7th character D because orthopedic follow-up is arranged; dropping the external cause codes or using W19 (unspecified fall) instead of W11 (fall from ladder); coding the wrist as S63.- (sprain) because the chief complaint says wrist pain
